QF.id: AIFM Fund Monitoring, Reporting, and Exit_22

question.text: Per Chapter 15 of the NISM Series XIX-C workbook (pp. 427-428) and the SEBI Master Circular for AIFs on the Stewardship Code, how many guiding principles constitute the SEBI Stewardship Code applicable to AIFs on their LISTED investee exposures?

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 15 (pp. 427-428) of the Series XIX-C workbook and the SEBI Master Circular on the Stewardship Code for AIFs lay down SIX principles: (1) stewardship policy formulation and disclosure; (2) conflict-of-interest policy; (3) monitoring of investee companies; (4) intervention policy; (5) voting policy and disclosure; (6) periodic stewardship reporting. The stem is anchored to Chapter 15 / the current SEBI Master Circular, so 6 is uniquely correct. The Trap: Options 4 and 8 are simple distractors. Option B (7 principles) is plausible because UK / IRDAI variants list more principles, but the SEBI AIF version is 6. Note: The original stem did not anchor itself to a specific chapter / circular, which created internal conflict with another workbook page (p. 123) referencing "five principles" and listing only Principles 1-5. The stem has been narrowed to Chapter 15 / the current SEBI Master Circular and the "5 principles" distractor replaced with "7 principles" so the keyed answer is uniquely correct. Source: FINAL_Series-XIX-C_AIF Managers_Ver-Dec-2025.pdf, pp. 123 (flagged for source reconciliation), 427-428.
